data.narrative:
Curio Solutions is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Ed McGinnis and Pete Zweifel that has raised $16M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private-stage entities including Fuse Energy, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter operating within the nuclear energy sector.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $16M total raised baseline, a standard metric for Series A advancement, yielding $32M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient comparable data points meeting narrow stage and valuation-tier filters within nuclear energy; while 4 same-sector peers exist, none of the tighter peer cohorts (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) reached the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median estimation. Broader sector comparison would introduce excessive noise given nuclear energy's heterogeneity.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $27M (low) to $37M (high), with a median of $32M. This range reflects the stage-progression method and inherent uncertainty bands around it. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct comparable transaction data at equivalent stages and the structural heterogeneity of the nuclear energy sector, which limits peer-based corroboration. A subsequent round or expanded comp set would strengthen conviction in this range.
